## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- Standard partition filter (most common pattern)
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND placed_order_cnt_30d > 0
  AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
  AND grass_date = date'${BIZ_PRE_TWO_DAYS}'

-- Single day (T-1, fixed date)
WHERE grass_date = date_add(current_date(), -1)
  AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'TH', 'VN', 'SG', 'TW', 'BR')

-- Date range (30-day window for item GMV)
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${BIZ_TIME}') - INTERVAL '30' DAY AND date('${BIZ_TIME}')
  AND day(grass_date) <> month(grass_date)
  AND day(grass_date) NOT IN (15, 25)

-- Active items filter (by 30-day order count)
AND placed_order_cnt_30d > 0

-- Data quality
AND item_id IS NOT NULL
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- Pattern 1: JOIN with ads_advertise_mkt_1d on item_id + grass_region (supply data)
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_nd__reg_s0_live a
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live b
  ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region AND a.item_id = b.item_id

-- Pattern 2: JOIN with traffic_omni_oa on grass_region (active item/shop count)
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live a
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) AS item_count
    FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_nd__reg_s0_live
    WHERE ...
    GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date
) b ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region

-- Pattern 3: JOIN on item_id + grass_region + grass_date (item GMV for boost coefficient)
JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, item_id, gmv_usd_1d, grass_date
    FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_nd__reg_s0_live
    WHERE ...
) c ON a.grass_region = c.grass_region AND a.item_id = c.item_id AND a.grass_date = c.grass_date

-- Pattern 4: JOIN with winner_items on item_id + grass_region (seller incentive)
LEFT JOIN item_order_30d o ON w.item_id = o.item_id AND w.grass_region = o.grass_region
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- Active items count (most common, used in supply data dashboards)
SELECT grass_region, COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) AS item_count
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_nd__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND placed_order_cnt_30d > 0
  AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
  AND grass_date = date'${BIZ_PRE_TWO_DAYS}'
GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date

-- Daily active items count over time (adoption rate tracking)
SELECT grass_date, COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) AS active_items
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_nd__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND placed_order_cnt_30d > 0
  AND grass_date >= DATE '2024-11-01'
  AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'BR', 'PH', 'TH', 'MY', 'VN', 'SG', 'TW')
GROUP BY grass_date

-- Shop-level 7-day GMV aggregation (churn analysis)
SELECT shop_id, grass_region,
    SUM(placed_order_cnt_1d) AS placed_order_cnt_7d,
    SUM(gmv_usd_1d) AS gmv_usd_7d
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_nd__reg_s0_live
WHERE item_id IS NOT NULL
  AND grass_region = 'ID'
  AND grass_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-09' AND DATE '2025-04-15'
  AND shop_id IN (SELECT shop_id FROM target_shop)
GROUP BY shop_id, grass_region

-- Item-level 30-day order count for ranking (winner seller selection)
SELECT item_id, grass_region, placed_order_cnt_30d
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_nd__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date_add(current_date(), -1)
  AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'TH', 'VN', 'SG', 'TW', 'BR')
```

### Snippet 1: Active Item Identification -- Supply Data Dashboard

```sql
-- Source: workflows/gaorong/ads_supply_data/Data Processing/active_item_shop_count
SELECT a.grass_region, COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) AS item_count
FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_nd__reg_s0_live a
WHERE a.tz_type = 'local'
  AND a.placed_order_cnt_30d > 0
```

### Snippet 2: Winner Seller Selection -- Ranking by 30-Day Order Count

```sql
-- Source: workflows/.../target_product_v2_seller_list_sp
item_order_30d AS (
    SELECT item_id, grass_region, placed_order_cnt_30d
    FROM mp_order.dws_item_gmv_nd__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = date_add(current_date(), -1)
      AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'TH', 'VN', 'SG', 'TW', 'BR')
)
SELECT w.shop_id, w.item_id, w.grass_region,
    COALESCE(o.placed_order_cnt_30d, 0) AS order_cnt_30d,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY w.shop_id, w.grass_region
        ORDER BY o.placed_order_cnt_30d DESC
    ) AS rn
FROM winner_items w
LEFT JOIN item_order_30d o ON w.item_id = o.item_id AND w.grass_region = o.grass_region
-- Top 50 items per shop by 30d order count selected for incentive
```
